text.content:
This is clearly the heart of the floor: Weeping, deliberately spacious, and unmistakably occupied.

GM Notes

Milestone: This is where the floor's story comes to a head: A formula for a rogue homunculus conclave to end all suffering - or all resistance - was hidden in the Cisterns below, and someone just found the first ingredient.

Hazard: A ward etched into the doorway reacts to anyone who isn't already marked as an ally (DC 15 to detect and counter).
